summary: Iterasi 8 (Kelas multi-sesi + materi per pertemuan + presensi per pertemuan) tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (validation, /classes/mine tutor+admin scope, materials per session with creator_role, attendance persisted per session, student /schedule & /classes/{id}, 403 for non-enrolled, invalid session 404, delete cascade). Frontend: All key UI flows verified — admin creates confirmed slot via API, then via UI admin/schedule loads with session chips, create dialog opens with weekly generator + add/remove session, admin/classes expands 3 sessions and saves material + attendance (no fav-btn for admin), tutor/classes shows own class, student/schedule expands showing 3 sessions + material link + 'Hadir' badge, student is read-only. Cleanup deletion successful (200) — no lingering TEST_ data.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (accessibility warning in console) — minor a11y

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to Buat Kelas/Materi/Presensi dialogs to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_classes.py: DELETE /materials/{material_id} allows admin unconditionally — OK by design (admin manages all).
utils.class_sessions() correctly synthesizes single session for legacy slots; verified for 3 seed slots.
Attendance upsert uses composite key (slot_id, session_id, student_id) — presensi tidak bercampur antar pertemuan (verified in test_mark_and_persist_per_session).
Student /classes/{id} returns 403 for non-enrolled student (verified with rizki@lms.id).
SlotBody accepts empty sessions[] and empty date — properly rejected with 400 'Minimal satu pertemuan diperlukan'.
seed_data_creation: During tests created TEST_ slots + tutor bid + admin assign + materials + attendance; all cleaned up after tests via DELETE /api/admin/slots/{id} which cascades bids/materials/attendance. 3 seed slots preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_classes.py can be re-run with `pytest -o addopts='' backend/tests/test_iter8_classes.py`. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env fallback. DatePicker (gen-start-date, session-date-*) is a shadcn calendar popover (not a native input) — Playwright must click the trigger then a day cell; do NOT use page.fill on it. When testing attendance dialog, wait ~1s after opening for roster fetch to complete before asserting att-row-* count or fav-btn presence.
